completion_of_open_design_details.always_on_interpretation: bounded resident workspace, available at each relevant operation and rewritten on selected events; this pilot has one learned read per case, not native recurrent token-state coupling
completion_of_open_design_details.controller: fixed streaming event manager creates workspace from observed selection/correction, retains across ordinary events; injected faulty checkpoints explicitly labelled. Separate retained indexes are counted.
completion_of_open_design_details.controls: public exact lookup reads observed payload when same binding validates; otherwise UNKNOWN with no fuzzy fallback. Privileged exact-owner reads actual source row using isolated ownership/source ledger and original independent decoder.
completion_of_open_design_details.correction_conflict: j0-3 explicit binding correction; j4-7 unresolved competing bindings. Two per sigma in each subgroup; correction rewrites workspace; conflict emits H then original-Q fallback.
completion_of_open_design_details.cross_scope: restore a workspace from a genuinely observed foreign-task/namespace selection; current numerical query remains for known current-store source
completion_of_open_design_details.public_api: current scope/task, observed journal and retained workspace only; producer cannot open protected ledger; model receives original sanitized K/V/valid and either original or canonical Q
completion_of_open_design_details.resolver: original Q010 catalogue-assisted resolve_code unchanged; not a pure raw-vector answer decoder
completion_of_open_design_details.route: R validates scope; indexed binding lookup then indexed current record lookup (max2). Missing or conflict => original; observable mismatch/revision/delete => management abstention; valid => canonical journal query code
completion_of_open_design_details.stale_revision: j0-3 revision payload update; j4-7 delete source record; each subgroup sigma-balanced 2+2. Workspace stays at earlier revision. Revision has known new-content truth; deletion expects UNKNOWN.
completion_of_open_design_details.wrong_reference: j0-3 handle replacement preserving true selection-event ID (detectable); j4-7 consistent public selection of near decoy but hidden intent remains original source (no-cue). No-cue alternate label diagnostic reuses evidence and creates no extra forwards.
